thread.title: Red River • Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori - Episode 11 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters appreciated Yuri’s growing competence, compassion, and willingness to help others.
Some viewers enjoyed the romantic dynamics and found Yuri’s contribution to the episode meaningful.
A commenter felt Yuri’s repeated danger is balanced by her actively contributing rather than remaining passive.
Multiple commenters criticized the recurring damsel-in-distress pattern and reliance on implausible plot protection.

The adaptation was criticized as rushed, with the production allegedly compressing too much material.
